messages:
mia: Quick thought — want to do a casual game night + happy hour next Friday (6/6)? Two options: in-person at The Rusty Cue for board games + drinks, or hybrid Jackbox + pizza for folks remote. React with emoji: :board_game: = Rusty Cue, :video_game: = Jackbox/pizza, :beers: = just drinks at the pub. Who's in?
sam: Love this. I can do either but prefer Jackbox if it's rain + late trains. :+1:
ben: Count me in for in-person — been meaning to try that new cocktail menu. :cocktail:
carla: Hybrid works for me. Also can bring Catan if we're doing boards. :board_game:
tina: Jackbox sounds fun and low-effort. Also can volunteer to order pizza. :pizza:
mia: Awesome. If enough :board_game: we'll book Rusty Cue (they have tables for 8). If mostly :video_game: we'll set up a Zoom room + Jackbox link and order pizza for SF folks.
ben: If we do Rusty Cue, what time? 7pm?
sam: 7pm works. For Jackbox, 7:30 PT would be better for east coast folks.
mia: Let's do a quick headcount. If you're coming in-person, say "IRL". If remote or want hybrid, say "HYBRID". If only drinks, say "DRINKS".
carla: IRL
tina: HYBRID (pizza pls)
ben: IRL
sam: HYBRID — leaning remote if trains are rough that night
mia: Great — so far 2 IRL, 2 HYBRID. I'll ping The Rusty Cue about a provisional hold for 8 at 7:00 and make a pizza order backup.
dev-bot: Event created: "Redwood Game Night" on Fri Jun 6 • 7:00 PM — RSVP link: https://calendar.example.com/event/abc123 (auto-reminder 1 day before)
carla: Yay thanks! Also can someone bring an extra power strip for laptops?
tina: I have one, bringing it.
b>en: Could we do a quick Doodle for people who care about the date? I'm out the following Friday. https://doodle.example.com/rdw-game-night
mia: Good call — I'll add the poll later today. For now, emoji/reacts will decide venue. Please react by EOD tomorrow. :sparkles: :beers:
carla: Also tagging @marketing in case anyone wants to join social night.
sam: Woo! Excited.
